rationale: C24 is expressly identified in the child's preamble as the directive declaring the national emergency being supplemented, and it plausibly supplied most of the child's sanctions-order framework. The child preserves C24's property-blocking formula and then reproduces, with modest adaptations, its provisions covering contributions and services, evasion and conspiracy, the IEEPA donations determination, definitions, lack of prior notice, Treasury implementation and internal redelegation, agency assistance, and official Federal Government and United Nations business. The child's PEESA-specific designation, waiver, and visa machinery is new, but it is inserted into a concrete drafting architecture materially shared with C24. C04 and C10 have similarly close sanctions structures, but C24 is stronger because of the express relationship and the same Russian national emergency.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in order to take additional steps with respect to the national emergency declared in [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 15, 2021 (Blocking Property With Respect To Specified Harmful Foreign Activities of the Government of the Russian Federation)
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby declare a national emergency to deal with that threat.
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly operates as an additional step under the national emergency created by C24, establishing a direct administrative relationship rather than mere topical similarity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all property and interests in property of such person that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any United States person are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All property and interests in property that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any United States person of the following persons are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in
shared_material.explanation: The central operative blocking provision uses essentially the same detailed jurisdictional and prohibitory formula, adapted to persons identified under PEESA.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include: (a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services by, to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; and (b) the receipt of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services from any such person.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include: (a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services by, to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; and (b) the receipt of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services from any such person.
shared_material.explanation: This operative section is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited. (b) Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited. (b) Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.
shared_material.explanation: The child repeats C24's two-part anti-evasion and conspiracy provision verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For those persons whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order who might have a constitutional presence in the United States, I find that because of the ability to transfer funds or other assets instantaneously, prior notice to such persons of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would render those measures ineffectual.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For those persons whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order who might have a constitutional presence in the United States, I find that because of the ability to transfer funds or other assets instantaneously, prior notice to such persons of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would render those measures ineffectual.
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive prior-notice finding and its associated determination are carried over essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA and PEESA, as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this order. The Secretary of the Treasury may, consistent with applicable law, redelegate any of these functions within the Department of the Treasury.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA, as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this order. The Secretary of the Treasury may, consistent with applicable law, redelegate any of these functions within the Department of the Treasury.
shared_material.explanation: The child adopts C24's implementation and internal-redelegation provision while adding PEESA to the delegated authorities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing in this order shall prohibit transactions for the conduct of the official business of the Federal Government or the United Nations, including its programs, funds, and other entities and bodies, as well as its specialized agencies and related organizations, by employees, grantees, and contractors thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Nothing in this order shall prohibit transactions for the conduct of the official business of the Federal Government or the United Nations (including its specialized agencies, programs, funds, and related organizations) by employees, grantees, and contractors thereof.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C24's combined Federal Government and United Nations official-business exemption, with minor elaboration.
